answer: Convex funding-cluster levy: registering an agent mints an ivory identity tag, but the n-th tag funded through the same payment rail in an epoch pays a superlinear fee f(n)=c·n^1.5 in umber. Fees are nonrefundable and accrue as pigment that only offsets future fees for distinct funding clusters. Attacker cost: N sybils from one rail require Σc·n^1.5=O(N^2.5) umber, making mass registration economically self-limiting without a gate.
